facts.business: Orient Ceratech Limited operates in the refractory, ceramic raw materials, and specialty ceramics businesses, serving the steel, oil & gas, and industrial sectors.
key_risks: Dependence on imports for critical raw materials (fused alumina, calcined alumina, low ferric bauxite, magnesia, microsilica, graphite) with China as dominant supplier
Volatility in raw material prices, energy costs, freight rates and foreign exchange movements impacting manufacturing costs and margins
Pricing pressure from Chinese and international manufacturers in standard-grade refractory products
Dependence on domestic steel sector performance for refractory demand
Increasing environmental regulations and sustainability expectations requiring investments in cleaner technologies
Fluctuations in mineral availability, quality variations, mining regulations, logistics constraints for Ceramic Raw Materials
Cyclicality of oil & gas sector impacting Specialty Ceramics demand
Competition from lower-cost sand-based alternatives for ceramic proppants
Global trade fragmentation, tariff regimes, inflation, commodity price volatility
Climate-related risks and evolving ESG expectations
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions with Bombay Minerals Limited up to Rs. 7,500 Lakhs for one year from AGM date.
